csv_scope_of_work: Lexington Children s Museum interviewed and selected Champlin|EOP Architects to provide full design and contract administration services for a new purpose-built museum facility (35,000-45,000 sq. ft.). The proposed museum is to be located at 525 De Roode Street, Lexington, KY 40508, which will serve as a dynamic hub for learning, creativity, and discovery. The architectural scope includes exhibit galleries, public areas, administrative offices, back-of-house operations, building systems and exterior design harmonized with the neighborhood. In addition to the integration of innovative exhibits per the 2024 Master Plan. Owner s intent to enter into a contract with the successful Construction Manager in June of 2026 and immediately begin construction management activities and meetings. It is estimated that the design phase of the project will last until July 2029 with the Construction Manager providing Pre-Construction phase services as outlined above
